The structure of Ca2HfO3 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—Ca4Hf2O6—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers with eight O neighbors and Hf centers with six O neighbors, while O centers have five geometric neighbors (two Ca, one Hf, and two O). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Ca and O polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Ca and Hf polyhedra.
